translationRepairs: for an offense he was demoted to Prefect of Chaozhou.
In the fourth year of Xianqing, for an offense he was demoted to Prefect of Chaozhou.
s0034 opens with 顯慶四年; the literal omits that date while the rest of the proposed sentence matches 坐事，貶為潮州刺史.

Previously, selection assemblies had no limit and appointees were filled as they arrived; as the times gradually became peaceful the candidates grew somewhat numerous, and Jiao first requested that a great assembly be held at the winter solstice and concluded by the end of spring—this is practiced to the present.

Previously, selection assemblies had no limit and appointees were filled as they arrived; as the times gradually became peaceful the candidates grew somewhat numerous, and Jiao first requested that a great assembly be held in early winter and concluded by the end of spring—this is practiced to the present.
Focus unit has 冬初一時大集; 冬初 is early winter, not the winter solstice (冬至). Replacing “at the winter solstice” with “in early winter” corrects the season without other changes.
He later served as long-term governor of Yizhou.
He later served as Administrator of Yizhou.
s0040 has 益州長史; 長史 is the prefectural Administrator office title, not “long-term governor” (a false temporal reading of 長). “Administrator of Yizhou” restores the office correctly.
At the time the Duke of Ying Li Ji was Long Governor; he deeply honored him.
At the time the Duke of Ying Li Ji was Administrator; he deeply honored him.
s0076 has 英國公李勣為長史; 長史 is Administrator, and “Long Governor” invents a mistranslation of the same title. The proposed literal keeps Duke of Ying Li Ji and the honor clause intact.
Li Renbao, prefect of Dao, and his brother, magistrate of Yuci, were framed by Tang Fengyi for private divination plotting to restore the Li house.
Li Renbao, prefect of Dao, and his younger brother Changsha, magistrate of Yuci, were framed by Tang Fengyi for private divination plotting to restore the Li house.
s0162 names 弟榆次令長沙; 長沙 is the younger brother’s personal name and 弟 marks younger brother. The idiomatic had dropped the name; the proposal restores both without inventing content.
Thereupon Lady Pang's death was reduced; she was banished beyond the Ling tables; Yougong was removed from name and made commoner.
Thereupon Lady Pang's death was reduced; she was banished beyond the Lingnan frontier; Yougong was removed from name and made commoner.
s0193 has 流於嶺表; 嶺表 is the Lingnan frontier region, not “Ling tables.” The replacement “beyond the Lingnan frontier” matches the Chinese place term.
